notes.title: DevBlog #4: In-office Staff Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, aspiring server owners! [/h3]
We are excited to share the latest update for Server Owner Tycoon, which focuses on the staff update. In this update, we'll talk about the changes we have made to the staff system and how we made it more alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/90e748cf55ac516a3b9bd33172ed24115b398e02.png[/img]

[h3][b]Quick Recap: [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] New In-Office Staff Update
[*] Improved Management and Efficiency
[*] Enhanced Staff Satisfaction
[/list]


[h2]In-Office Staff Update[/h2]

We're introducing a new feature that will make managing your staff even more engaging and immersive. We've listened to your feedback and implemented an in-office staff update that will transform your experience of running your online business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/a809058d4344c33bf1589506a3bfad88ffe2cfb2.png[/img]

What does this update entail? Well, in the past, your staff were only visible on a UI panel, and you couldn't see them working. But now, your staff members will be moving around your office in real-time. You'll see them actively performing tasks, chatting with each other, and moving between different workstations. This visual representation of your team will allow you to monitor their progress and intervene if necessary. You'll be able to assign tasks more efficiently and provide support to your staff members when needed.

Your staff is primarily managed in-office but you can now choose to have them work remotely, which will make it harder to satisfy and monitor them but will reduce your overall per employee costs.

[h2]Improved Management and Efficiency[/h2]

But it's not just about managing your team more effectively. Managing your staff’s work in real-time will also increase their job satisfaction and happiness. They'll feel more connected to their work and feel like they're part of a thriving company. This will improve their overall performance and ensure that your server is running at full efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/01ee58951f3befbbb98264d72667daedbd8c348c.png[/img]

[h2]Staff Satisfaction[/h2]

Your staff's satisfaction influences their behavior: 

Scolding them, not training them, not actively participating in your server's life or being too greedy with the money will cause their satisfaction to decrease. 

Providing them with benefits, better gear and praises on the other hand, will increase their satisfaction and engagement towards you, your server and your community. 

It is good to remember that unhappy staff are more likely to sabotage you, while satisfied staff will go the extra mile, often without needing extra pay. A balance one must find to keep its server alive.

We hope you enjoy this new feature and look forward to hearing your feedback. As always, please feel free to reach out to us with any comments or suggestions you may have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/a557283ded736297151ebeec72535002f727ea66.gif[/img]

Thank you for supporting Server Owner Tycoon, and we'll see you in the virtual office!
—
Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/dfgGrzh]Discord[/url]!

There you can see the latest news about Server Owner Tycoon.

Thank you for your support, and we’re excited to see your overpowered staff members!

notes.title: Dev Blog #2: Character Customization
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Server Owners![/h3]

We're back with our second edition of DevBlogs for Server Owner Tycoon! As always, we're working hard to make your experience as authentic and engaging as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/3fbe63d628b6bf55a0d5047feef12cfd9d3fa02d.png[/img]

[b][h3]Table of content:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Added 10 hairstyles;
[*] Added 18 skin colors;
[*] Added 10 outfits;
[*] Added 6 hair colors;
[*] Added 4 Skill Categories and Skill Points
[/list]
[h2]Character Customization[/h2]

We understand that you want to be in control of your server, and what better way to do that than by customizing your own character to run it?

In this update, we're proud to announce that we've added a wide range of customization options to help you create a character that truly reflects you. We have added 10 hairstyles,18 skin colors, 10 outfits and 6 hair colors. Now make your character as unique as you are. We believe that players should feel like they are the ones running the server, and character customization is an essential part of that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/f3ce4f2f270f66ed7d1f480730974a80224fa7db.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/e6a5234993f94c5853ddbae17fc6745bf102dadc.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/befaf0396d886be4d97af749fa055471ae7e93e7.png[/img]

But that's not all! We've also added an option to name your character after yourself, and even name your server too! It's all about making your experience as personal and immersive as possible.

[h2]Skill Points[/h2]

Today, we're excited to introduce skill points to Server Owner Tycoon. With four categories—Communication, Productivity, Work Ethic, and Skill—these points enhance task efficiency, reduce time spent, and improve task quality. While we won't delve deep into this system now, stay tuned for a future DevBlog where we'll unveil more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/172fa8ca945267f57408ea4f589798a6e062e7cb.png[/img]

We're excited to see the creative characters you all come up with! Don't forget to share your screenshots on social media with the hashtag #ServerOwnerTycoon if you have access to the game.

Stay tuned for our next devblog, where we'll be explaining more server customizations you can make to create the ultimate online empire!

—

Don’t forget to join our Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/dfgGrzh]https://discord.gg/dfgGrzh[/url]

There you can see the latest news about Server Owner Tycoon. 

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to see your characters!

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Welcome back!
notes.content:
Hey there, aspiring server owners! It's been a while, hasn't it? We've missed you. We know it's been a long time since our last update, and for that, we sincerely apologize. But fear not! We're back and more determined than ever to bring you the ultimate server ownership experience.

We've made the decision to start posting regular devblogs (around once a month) to keep you, our amazing community, in the loop about what we're working on behind the scenes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/383e6595e8191836931208e16277d1c7101cfca3.png[/img]

[h3]Quick Recap:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added 100+ furniture items to the store;
[*] Added a feature to expand the office land;
[*] Added Officeware - decorations with extra effect;
[/list]
[h2]Build your dream Office[/h2]

Let's start by the start (where else?), where everything will happen, your office. It isn't just a workspace—it's your sanctuary for entrepreneurship. Begin with a small, cozy nook and watch it evolve alongside your ambitions. We've meticulously crafted more than 100 furniture options for you to choose from, from stylish desks to inviting decorations, allowing you to create a space uniquely yours. As your empire grows, expand your office to accommodate your team and aspirations, turning it into the ultimate hub for success.

[h2]Office Expansion Now Available[/h2]

In Server Owner Tycoon, expanding your office space is not just about increasing square footage—it's about elevating your presence in the virtual business world. With our new expansion feature, you can acquire additional room to grow your office according to your ambitions. Begin by adding a modest extension, increasing your workspace and providing room for additional staff or amenities. But why stop there? With our largest variant, you can transform your office into a sprawling complex, complete with cozy decorations and ample room for expansion. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/0efd2fc15c85a7967a96d69707031981be2ab6fe.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/0efd2fc15c85a7967a96d69707031981be2ab6fe.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Officeware[/h2]

It's not just about furniture. We've also added, on top of the current 100+ shop items, a feature that allows you to purchase useful officeware, which will be used in combination with a feature that we'll be explaining in a future blog article. These items will help you streamline your work processes and manage your team more efficiently.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/0a8b71a5fafd46f8e7fe289169b5505a8ce7e017.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680047/0a8b71a5fafd46f8e7fe289169b5505a8ce7e017.gif[/img][/url]

We know that building your dream office is an important part of your Server Owner Tycoon experience, and we're excited to offer you these new customization features. We believe that having a workspace that's tailored to your needs will help you to reach your full potential as a server owner.
—
We hope you're as excited about this new feature as we are. Stay tuned for more developer blogs. As of next time we’ll talk about character customization and upcoming releases (Wen Demo?)!

Don’t forget to join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/dfgGrzh]https://discord.gg/dfgGrzh[/url]

There you can see the latest news about Server Owner Tycoon. Connect with our community and upload your office buildings in the future!

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to see the offices that you create in the game!
